description: Attendance save: secretary-only write with optimistic concurrency and totals on read.
precondition: InProgress meeting; actor is an active secretary; current version token known.

cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: user S; entries: [{Internal, A, Present, current token of A}].
cases.log: Participant A: Attendance Present, AttendanceVersion 1, recorded by S. One audit row MeetingAttendanceRecorded (actor S, object Meeting) with before/after of A. Attendance change event published.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is S.
cases.return: Result Saved: changedCount 1; one entry for A with attendance "Present", a new version token, recorder S and recorded time; 200 / MSG147.

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, A, Absent, current token}, {Guest, G, Present, current token}].
cases.log: A and G both get version 1 and recorder S. One audit row with two entries. One change event published.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is S.
cases.return: Result Saved: changedCount 2; A is Absent, G is Present; 200 / MSG147.

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, A, Present, token of version 1}].
cases.log: No audit row, no save, no change event.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
A is already Present at version 1.
cases.return: Result Saved: changedCount 0; the entry for A with unchanged version token; 200 / MSG147 (valid no-op).

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, A, Absent, token of version 1}] (revision of a recorded value).
cases.log: Audit before: Present, version 1; after: Absent, version 2.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
A is Present at version 1.
cases.return: Result Saved: changedCount 1; A is now Absent at version 2.

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, A, Present, token}] (G not included).
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Only one of the two people is submitted.
cases.return: Result Saved: changedCount 1; G stays unmarked; partial roster is allowed.

cases.inputs: entries: [{Guest, G, Present, token}] where G was revoked.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Request ends up with a Guest id that is not a current invitation (revoked).
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
A was removed from the roster (AssignmentStatus Removed) after the client loaded.

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, A, Present, token of version 0}].
cases.log: Nothing saved; no entry is partially applied even when other entries in the request are valid.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Another save has already moved A to version 1.
cases.return: Failure Stale; 409 / MSG151; the client must reload.

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, a random GUID, Present, valid-format token}].
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Entry id does not exist in this meeting.
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is S.
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is S.
cases.return: Failure Invalid; 400 / MSG148 (only Present or Absent may be saved).

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, A, Present, token}, {Internal, A, Absent, token}] (same person twice).
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is S.

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, A, Present, expectedVersion: "abc"}] (not a 64-character hex token).
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is S.
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Request body was not application/json.
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Request body exceeded 64 KiB.
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Request body was not valid JSON for the attendance form.
Meeting in status Published (not started).
Actor is its active Secretary.
Meeting in status Ended; actor is its active Secretary.
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is the Chair (not Secretary).
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is a plain Member who can read the running meeting.
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is the meeting organizer who has no roster seat.
Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor's account is deactivated.

cases.inputs: actor: guest session G (UserId null); entries: [{Guest, G, Present, token}].
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Actor is a verified Guest session of this meeting.
cases.return: Failure Forbidden; 403; a Guest cannot record attendance.

cases.inputs: actor: guest session of a different meeting.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
Guest session belongs to another meeting.
Meeting is not visible to the actor (user is neither organizer, approver nor on the roster).

cases.inputs: meetingId: unknown GUID; actor: any active user.
preconditions: Meeting id does not exist.

cases.log: Pending changes discarded; error logged; no change event.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
The database fails while committing the save.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 / MSG150; the client must reload before retrying.

cases.inputs: entries: [{Internal, A, Present, token of that version}].
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
A's attendance version is already at the maximum value of 64-bit integers.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 / MSG150 (the version increment overflows).

cases.log: Attendance and audit row are committed; a warning is logged for the failed event.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress with an active Secretary S, a current Member A (attendance Unknown, version 0) and a current Guest invitation G (attendance Unknown, version 0).
The realtime publisher throws after the commit.
cases.return: Result Saved: changedCount 1; 200 / MSG147; the failed push does not turn the save into an error.
